as_told.title: Van Flandern and Harrington both died of throat cancer

plain: Two astronomers, Thomas Van Flandern and Robert Harrington, led the search for an unknown planet, and possibly a companion star, at the edge of our solar system, and both later died of throat cancer even though neither smoked. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this without naming a source, though once he points to a work called The Stage of Time, and he notes that the deaths came within a few years of each other. He brings it up because it hints that their deaths may have been linked to what they were looking for.
